sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins followed by a draw, establishing themselves as clear leaders. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches, making this a strong opportunity for the leaders to extend their unbeaten run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in what should favour the visitors' title ambitions, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a potentially tight encounter between two mid-table contenders. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community in a local derby with both sides looking to climb the table. Bilston Town, currently sixth and in strong recent form, visit Foley Meir in an important fixture. New Mills, winless in their last two, host mid-table Market Drayton Town who themselves have lost their last two matches. Barnton welcome Shawbury United, with the hosts enjoying recent momentum while the visitors struggle with five straight defeats. Cheadle Heath Nomads, anchored in the bottom half, travel to Telford Town in a clash between two sides with serious relegation concerns. Crewe, also battling near the foot of the table, host Allscott Heath, with both teams looking to improve on recent poor runs. Brereton Social entertain bottom-dwellers Widnes Town, who have taken just 2 points from seven games and are looking to finally secure a win.
